_what: The development loop's cloud half, read by the fix-from-house skill and by devloop-guard (always from the BASE branch, so a PR cannot loosen what it is judged by). reports_repo is the private repository brAIn files issues into (owner/name); the routine does nothing until it is set. house_login is the GitHub login the house files those issues as (configurable: set it to whichever account holds the house's token). version_only_files are the manifests a devloop PR may change only the version line of. grader_paths are the files that judge a fix (the guard, the workflows, the skill and the small safety suite in tests/): a devloop PR that touches one fails, and they change only in a pull request a person asked for, except retro_paths (the lessons the loop's retro records), which a devloop-meta/ PR may change. tiers maps changed paths to a risk tier (A copy/UI/docs, B logic in one add-on, C safety areas or logic across add-ons); the skill reads the tier to decide how many reviewers a merge needs. canary_window_hours is how long after a release the house's health is watched before a fix counts as held; stand_down_days is how long a declined report silences its fingerprint. See docs/design/devloop.md and docs/design/self-learning-plan-2026-11.md.

tiers._what: Globs over repository paths (** crosses folders, * does not). C wins over everything but M; a change is A only when every path is in A, a version_only_files version bump, or a pure addition to a test file; otherwise B when the rest lies inside one add-on (Morph is brAIn's) and C when it spans add-ons or lies outside any.
